title: AI-supported screening strategy could improve cervical cancer detection in low-resource settings
description: Combining HPV testing with artificial intelligence–based image analysis has shown efficacy in detecting precancerous lesions and guiding treatment decisions, according to a study led by the Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal). title: International Experts Explore the Future of More Resilient and Competitive North American Supply Chains
description: The forum, organized by the U.S. National Academy of Engineering and Tecnológico de Monterrey, brought together experts to explore how artificial intelligence, applied research, process optimization, and advanced manufacturing can strengthen industrial integration across Mexico, the United States, and Canada.The forum's topics address a central question for operations and strategy leaders: how can technology and specialized expertise be translated into decisions that improve supply chain performance and adaptability? MONTERREY, Mexico, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Transforming North America's supply chains requires building the knowledge, technology, and engineering capabilities needed to anticipate risks, optimize operations, and strengthen competitiveness. These challenges were the focus of the international forum From Resilience to New Opportunities: Building the North American Supply Chain of the Future, held at the Monterrey campus of Tecnológico de Monterrey.
